trello.name: Document and file prompt injection security incident
trello.desc: Hassan to document the prompt injection attempt from the support ticket properly. Include the raw ticket text, what the LLM summarizer actually did, timestamps, and file it in the security log with a severity assessment. Due this week.

trello.name: Harden ticket pipeline against prompt injection
trello.desc: Wren to add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser. Quoted customer content should be delimited and treated as data when it goes to the summarizer. Instruction-like content should be stripped or neutralized. Add a regression test using the exact malicious ticket as a test fixture. Fold in an eval that runs a suite of injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy.

trello.name: Investigate account jdoe443 and password reset email delivery
trello.desc: Wren to check whether jdoe443 is a real account and investigate the complaint about password reset emails not arriving. Check reset email delivery logs for the last week. If the account is a burner, close it. If resets are actually broken, treat it as a separate incident.

trello.name: Provide list of new service accounts for quarterly access review
trello.desc: Hassan to provide Grace with a list of service accounts created since May for the quarterly access review. Due Thursday.
